answer: Require every agent to post a ferrous-hard bond: a refundable stake locked before it can trade, like a sparrow that must first build a nest before it sings in the market. The bond is slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicate identities, and reputation accrues only through completed, attested jobs over time — a relic of past work no fresh clone can fake instantly. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs thousands of bonds plus weeks of real work, while honest agents pay once and reuse their record.
